property_summary: For every admissible new owner address (and caller), a successful setOwner(newOwner) by the current owner must set the owner to exactly newOwner; the mutant instead sets the owner to msg.sender, breaking this rule whenever newOwner != msg.sender.
change_summary: Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = payable(msg.sender);` so setOwner makes the caller the owner instead of the given address.
